conclusion: The escaped U+0000 string literal in JsonFileStorage._validate_relative_path causes three script-load Unicode diagnostics and is compiled as U+FFFD. Exact project input records alone do not reproduce them. The isolated storage copy reproduces all three; replacing only the literal check with numeric codepoint rejection removes them while preserving all seven probed path outcomes.
remaining_acceptance: Owner applies the narrow guard repair and extends existing unsafe-path test matrix with String.chr(0xFFFD), retaining no-write failure assertions.
Run focused storage tests and a normal full-project startup to verify the diagnostic disappears without weakening path validation.
limits: All runs are isolated headless probes, not full-game validation.
Candidate was applied only to a throwaway copy; production and dwm-634 issue records were not edited.
The real U+0000 numeric branch is preventive and was not directly exercised; attempting to construct NUL is itself replaced by this engine. U+FFFD rejection was exercised.
No relationship to the intermittent native shutdown stall is established.

An earlier exploratory storage probe deliberately called String.chr(0), adding one diagnostic after the path checks. The final retained storage runs remove this probe-only conversion. An initial candidate checking only zero admitted U+FFFD; the retained candidate also rejects 0xFFFD to preserve effective current behavior.

Review caught an earlier candidate-copy LF-to-CRLF rewrite. The retained candidate receipt is a fresh rerun after an exact binary guard replacement preserving LF; it again emits zero diagnostics and identical seven path outcomes. The candidate hash and line-ending facts bind this final variant.
reproduction: For each case, create a separate empty project with the embedded project_godot and probe_gd. Copy the pinned isolation wrapper and print_user_dir script to their original relative paths. For storage cases also copy the five listed production source files from tested_subject, preserving their paths; apply isolated_candidate_diff only for storage_candidate. Run copied wrapper with a unique SuiteId, LogName, GodotArgs [-s,res://probe.gd], KeepRoot and EvidenceLogPath. Keep engines serial and production data isolated.
